title: 特殊回调不可持久route

caseBaseline.steps: 构造有onDownload/onClose特殊业务回调的附件tab并重启。
caseBaseline.expected: 只持久化可序列化合法descriptor；函数不进入JSON；不可恢复项有明确策略。

I.chain: Real FileWorkspaceStore + FileWorkspacePersistence/SQLite + FileService/NativeFileBroker. Reconstructed store and FileService and reopened SQLite; no running App GUI claimed.

defects.initialResult: The real ordinary file pipeline initialized, but openAttachment was absent: 0/3 passed before product implementation. Initial failure retained in tests-r2.json.
defects.fix: Conditional runtime local attachment API; separate read-only capability and tab identity; callbacks remain only in current window. Ordinary legal descriptors are explicitly projected; callback attachments excluded from persisted routes/active and closed-route stack.
defects.retest: 3/3 dedicated real integration passed with 10 necessary ordinary store/panel regressions.

actualResult: A pinned ordinary Markdown tab and a local Chinese/space/emoji attachment with onDownload/onClose were opened. Only the ordinary legal descriptor entered actual SQLite JSON; ephemeral active route became null; callback keys and runtime identities did not enter JSON.

After disposing the original store and broker, reopening SQLite and constructing a fresh FileService/store recovered only the ordinary file using a new capability. No callback ran on shutdown/reconstruction and the ephemeral attachment was absent from closed-route restoration.

Actual native read/refresh retained attachment writable:false. Direct real service save/checkpoint/readDraft/resolveDraft attempts were refused with PERMISSION; attachment drafts list was empty and original bytes/hash unchanged.

The same physical file opened as one ordinary writable tab and two independent callback attachments remained three instances. Download invoked the correct host once; close invoked its host once; download after close rejected. Ordinary undo-close still restored a writable ordinary file.

implementation.entry: FileWorkspaceStore.openAttachment(root, relativePath, {key,onDownload?,onClose?}); only a current trusted local root is accepted.
implementation.readOnly: FileOpenRequest.readOnly narrows a newly issued document capability. Main document read/refresh preserves the flag; related file capabilities inherit it; save and draft mutation/restoration reject it. Separately opening the same local file as an ordinary document retains its existing policy.
implementation.nonRestorablePolicy: Callbacks require the originating host. No callback attachment route is persisted or added to undo-close; user-facing notice requires reopening from its source after close/restart.
implementation.ui: Conditional read-only/session-only notice and source download callback integrated into existing workspace/PDF/Notebook controls. Prototype uses a labeled synthetic attachment scenario only.
implementation.notAdded: No attachment origin list, remote mapping/download, cloud account or external service; no claim that J01 source matrix or V09 download matrix is complete.

prototypeBuild.warning: Existing large chunk/Rollup annotation warnings retained in log.

independentReview.result: No blocker in distinct tab identity, persistent/closed route exclusion, callback preservation on external workspace update, main readOnly refresh inheritance or save/draft denial.

earlierAttempts.detail: An extra -- reached Vitest and prevented correct file/report option selection. Interrupted; no result counted. Corrected invocation is used from r2.

earlierAttempts.result: 2/3 passed; checkpoint fixture accidentally included opId rejected by strict schema before PERMISSION guard. Corrected only fixture to valid checkpoint DTO, then 13/13 passed in r4.

earlierAttempts.detail: Dedicated test API cast needed unknown; concurrent F10 LSP previous?.abort was never. Both retained; final shared typecheck used after correction.
Used .js config path; repository config is .mjs. Corrected invocation r2 exited0.

boundaries: D20 formal required layer is I only; no extra P/A gate introduced or removed.
r6 supplies the packaged native broker and SQLite runtime. Current TypeScript executes under Electron Node tests; D20 changes are not claimed present in the r6 App.
Restart is a real store/service/SQLite reconstruction inside the integration test process, not a real packaged App restart.
Prototype model and build were verified; no new browser/CUA/physical UI acceptance or screenshots claimed.

The optional host is a synthetic local attachment callback in tests/prototype; actual product currently has no originating attachment list. This implements the approved conditional interface rather than inventing a remote origin.
Existing shared dirty changes preserved; no formal index or main documentation modified by this subagent.
